title: 六级主题练习 03 · 文化与全球协作
description: 原创缩编练习，学习情境为虚构，覆盖非听力题型。参考六级试卷中的传统文化、艺术技术和全球议题章节，全文为原创缩编内容。

sections.title: 写作
sections.instructions: 按题目要求完成写作。提交后查看参考范文，自行核对。
study_paragraphs: Faced with growing global exchange, students need both cultural confidence and cultural curiosity. Cultural confidence allows them to explain the history behind their traditions. Cultural curiosity encourages them to listen when people from other backgrounds describe their experiences. Universities can create this opportunity through joint projects, language exchanges and visits to local cultural sites. The purpose is not to repeat a fixed image of culture, but to understand how traditions change while important memories remain. Such understanding makes international cooperation more respectful and creative.

sections.title: 选词填空
sections.instructions: 从词库选词，每词只用一次。
paragraphs: A museum used digital tools to create a new exhibition about local craft. The team [1] ______ the movements of experienced makers and invited young designers to [2] ______ them in a different form. Visitors could compare original objects with new designs. The project did not claim technology could [3] ______ skill. It showed how documentation could [4] ______ knowledge and make it [5] ______ to people who could not visit a workshop.
study_paragraphs: A museum used digital tools to create a new exhibition about local craft. The team recorded the movements of experienced makers and invited young designers to interpret them in a different form. Visitors could compare original objects with new designs. The project did not claim technology could replace skill. It showed how documentation could preserve knowledge and make it accessible to people who could not visit a workshop.

questions.explanation: 第 1 空填入 recorded，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 2 空填入 interpret，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 3 空填入 replace，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 4 空填入 preserve，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 5 空填入 accessible，结合上下文和句法关系判断。

sections.title: 阅读理解 · A place for both answers
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A university invited students to suggest a theme for a public art wall. One group wanted local history and another wanted an abstract future design. The facilitator asked what they wanted visitors to feel. The final design combined historical symbols with changing colours. The compromise worked because participants agreed on a purpose before a picture.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · Power for a small business
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A rural training centre used a diesel generator for evening computer classes. Fuel prices rose and classes were cancelled when deliveries were late. A local engineer proposed solar power with batteries. It could not run every machine at once, so the centre changed its timetable and trained two residents to maintain it. Within a year, fuel costs fell and classes became more reliable.

sections.title: 翻译 · 中译英
sections.instructions: 完成翻译，提交后查看参考译文。
paragraphs: 中华文化在不断变化的社会中仍然具有生命力。年轻人通过学习传统节日、民间艺术和经典文学，能够更好地理解自己的文化背景。同时，他们也可以用新的方式讲述这些传统，使更多不同国家的人产生兴趣。
study_paragraphs: Chinese culture remains alive in a changing society. By learning about traditional festivals, folk arts and classic literature, young people can better understand their cultural background. They can also present these traditions in new ways and arouse interest among people from different countries.
